dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT / MCP-FUNC / MCP-PUTTYPE patterns typical of ORCA MCP framework

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) processing system - error message screen component for patient registration subsystem
purpose.summary: This program is the error-message screen component (ORCGPERR) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It handles screen transitions by evaluating MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT, performing initialization on LINK, and navigating back to the PERR error screen via PUTWINDOW calls to ORCDBMAIN.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (21 copybooks) for screen layout and linkage areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-defined areas (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
CALL to ORCDBMAIN (ORCA database/MCP main routine)
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (Shift-JIS or EUC-JP garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
MCP framework (PUTWINDOW, MCP-FUNC, MCP-PUTTYPE) typical of ORCA
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. High comment ratio (55%) is partly due to commented-out COPY statements and revision history blocks.
